text: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the unemployment rate fell to 3.7% in November, the lowest level in three months. The economy added 199,000 jobs, exceeding the 185,000 that economists had forecast. Job gains were concentrated in healthcare, government, and leisure and hospitality. Average hourly earnings rose 0.4% from the prior month and 4.0% year over year. Despite the positive headline numbers, labor force participation remained flat at 62.8%, suggesting that some potential workers remain on the sidelines.
